description: Home Affairs global visa processing times: how many days it took to finalise 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% of applications, per visa subclass and stream, with the date Home Affairs published the figures. Pass visaSubclass for one visa (with Home Affairs notes), or omit it to list every subclass. zh-CN / zh-TW return Chinese visa and stream names with the official English ones in nameEn / streamEn; Home Affairs notes stay in English. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

visaSubclass.description: Visa subclass number, e.g. "500", "189", "482", "485", "820", "600", "491". "491F" is accepted and treated as 491.

name: get_visa_processing_times
title: Get Australian visa processing times
